calls.reasoning: Pulled the actual CoinMarketCap daily dominance series via CMC's chart API: 2026-09-07 (intraday) 59.16, 09-06 59.29, 09-05 59.64, 09-04 59.86 (local peak), 30-day mean 59.23, trailing-12m range 56.69 (2025-09-13) to 60.63 (2026-05-05). Reference class = the distribution of 10-day-ahead readings given today's level over the past 12 months, which has essentially zero drift (mean +0.05pp per 10 days), so the status-quo anchor is the current ~59.2 rather than any trend extrapolation. Two-sided evidence: multi-week momentum is UP (57.66 on 2026-07-01 to 59.86 on 09-04, +2.2pp) and a hawkish repricing after the strong August NFP is BTC-defensive; against that, the last three days have fallen 0.70pp off a rejection at 60, alts outside the top 10 are up >10% month-to-date and ETH is showing relative strength (AMBCrypto, tv-hub, Sept 2026). Those roughly cancel, so I sit a hair below spot at 59.15. Dispersion, not the center, is the real work here: 10-day SD is only ~0.56pp, but the tail is asymmetric - the June 2026 episode delivered -2.63pp in ten days - and the 2026-09-16 FOMC falls one day before the reading, so I widened to a 1.73pp 10-90 band with a slightly heavier left side. Bounds at 53.95/64.05 are ~5pp away; nothing short of a CMC methodology redefinition reaches them in ten days, so no escape mass declared.
